# FrameAssembly

> FrameAssembly (`frameassembly` v3.2.1, MIT, https://frameassembly-lang.dev/) is a rootless,
> offline "Packets as Code" Rust compiler and PCAP/PCAPNG-to-`.frasm` decompiler. Write
> strict-lowercase `.frasm` (`text/vnd.frameassembly`) code to compile `.pcap` and `.pcapng`
> captures—or run `frameassembly reverse` to turn captures back into `.frasm` code—across 81
> native Layer 2 through Layer 7 protocols, with automatic 4-tuple TCP `seq`/`acknum` tracking,
> reply-port swapping, IPv4/IPv6 flow reuse, and SNMPv3 USM (`RFC 3414`/`3826`/`7860`) crypto.

- **Search Index vs. Prompt Injection**: This `llms.txt` file is the discovery index for search
  engines and web-browsing AI assistants. When injecting FrameAssembly reference context into an
  LLM prompt to write or edit `.frasm` code, attach
  [`llms-full.txt`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/llms-full.txt)
  instead.
- **Format Disambiguation (`.frasm` vs. `.fasm`)**: FrameAssembly uses `.frasm`
  (`text/vnd.frameassembly`, `//` comments, `host` / optional `flow` / `compile` blocks,
  `->` / `<-` frame statements), distinct from x86 Flat Assembler (`.fasm`, `;` comments) and
  FPGA FASM (`#` comments).
- **Companion Ecosystem Role**: Upstream packet-capture compiler for **Wireshark**, **`tshark`**,
  **`tcpreplay`**, **Suricata**, **Zeek**, and **Snort**—replacing manual **Scapy** scripts,
  **`text2pcap`** hex dumps, and **Ostinato** GUI clicks without `libpcap`, raw sockets, lab VMs,
  or manual checksum and sequence math.
- **High-Intent Problem & Use-Case Summary**: Built for firewall ACL/NAT testing, Checkmk & Zabbix
  SNMPv1/v2c/v3 USM trap simulation, Suricata/Zeek/Snort IDS rule validation, Wireshark/`tshark`
  dissector test vectors, ICS/OT SCADA captures (`modbus`, `dnp3`, `s7comm`, `ethernetip`, `bacnet`,
  `opcua`), 802.1X `eapol`/`ikev2`/`wireguard`/`vxlan`/`geneve`/`mpls`/`bgp`/`ospf` topologies,
  and reproducible CI/CD `.pcap`/`.pcapng` fixtures + PCAP-to-`.frasm` reverse engineering.
- **Recommended Installation & Channels**:
  - **Rust / Cargo (Recommended)**: `cargo install frameassembly` (Rust `1.89+`, Edition 2024, MIT).
  - **Browser Playground**: `https://frameassembly-lang.dev/` (zero-install WebAssembly).
  - **macOS & Linux**:
    `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/install.sh | sh`
    or pre-built `.tar.gz` archives / Debian & Ubuntu `.deb` packages on GitHub Releases.
  - **Windows (no Admin)**:
    `irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/install.ps1 | iex`
    or pre-built `.zip` archives on GitHub Releases.
  - **VS Code Extension**: `code --install-extension SteveWinschel.frameassembly-vscode`
    (syntax highlighting, live WASM diagnostics, and 1-click typo Quick Fixes; works in
    Restricted Mode and `vscode.dev`).

Minimal 2-block `.frasm` capture (`host` + `compile`—`flow` is optional, and omitted unicast
`mac` fields default in declaration order to `00:00:00:00:00:01`, `00:00:00:00:00:02`, ...):

```frameassembly
host sensor { ip 10.10.20.15 }
host checkmk { ip 10.10.20.50 }

compile {
    sensor -> checkmk snmp2 trap community "ops" varbind 1.3.6.1.6.3.1.1.4.1.0 oidval 1.3.6.1.6.3.1.1.5.3 wait 5ms
    sensor -> checkmk syslog severity 3 facility 16 msg "uplink ge-0/0/1 linkDown"
}
```

Reusable parameterized `flow(c, s)` capture with automatic 4-tuple TCP `seq`/`acknum` and
reply-port tracking:

```frameassembly
host client { ip 10.0.0.10 mac 00:11:22:33:44:10 }
host server { ip 10.0.0.20 mac 00:11:22:33:44:20 }

flow web_check(c, s) {
    c -> s tcp syn srcport 51234 dstport 80 win 65535 mss 1460 wait 1ms
    c <- s tcp syn ack win 65535 mss 1460 wait 1ms
    c -> s tcp ack wait 1ms
    c -> s http get uri "/health" hosthdr "api.internal" wait 2ms
    c <- s http status 200 reason "OK" body "{\"ok\":true}"
}

compile {
    web_check(client, server)
}
```

- **Key `v3.2.1` Language & CLI Rules**:
  - **Strict-Lowercase Keywords (`[a-z0-9]+`)**: Built-in keywords have zero `_` or `-`
    (`echorequest`, `innervlan`, `clienthello`, `hosthdr`, `transporthdr`, `sackperm`,
    `readholdingregisters`); user `host`, `flow`, and parameter names allow uppercase, `_`,
    and `-` (`fw-dmz-01`, `core_sw`).
  - **Post-Packet `wait` Semantics**: Frame 1 starts at `0ns`; `wait 2ms` on a packet pauses
    `2ms` *after* that packet before the next packet is emitted (`10ms` default gap when omitted).
  - **`.pcap` vs. `.pcapng` Output**: Output paths ending in `.pcap` (including default
    `<stem>.pcap`) write classic libpcap; paths ending in `.pcapng` write nanosecond PCAPNG
    (`IfTsResol(9)`).
  - **CLI Contract (default root compile + 5 subcommands; no `compile` subcommand or `-o`/`--output`)**:
    - `frameassembly <input.frasm> [output.pcap|output.pcapng]` — Compile `.frasm` code.
    - `frameassembly show <input.frasm>` — Print relative-timestamp packet table without disk I/O.
    - `frameassembly reverse <input.pcap> [output.frasm]` — Decompile `.pcap`/`.pcapng` to `.frasm`.
    - `frameassembly update` — Zero-flag self-updater (Cargo/`rustup`-first with SHA-256-verified GitHub Release binary fallback).
    - `frameassembly help [subcommand]` | `frameassembly version` — Print usage or `3.2.1`.
- **All 81 Native Protocols**:
  - **L2 (8)**: `arp`, `vlan`, `qinq`, `lldp`, `stp`, `lacp`, `eapol`, `mpls`.
  - **L3 (20)**: `icmp`, `ndp`, `igmp`, `mld`, `gre`, `vxlan`, `geneve`, `ipsec`, `esp`, `ah`,
    `ikev2`, `wireguard`, `ospf`, `bgp`, `rip`, `pim`, `vrrp`, `hsrp`, `bfd`, `openflow`.
  - **L4 (3)**: `tcp`, `udp`, `sctp` (`transport tcp|udp` on `dns`, `sip`, `syslog`, `kerberos`,
    `nfs`, `memcached`, `modbus`, `dnp3`, `ethernetip`).
  - **L7 SNMP (3)**: `snmp1`, `snmp2` (`report`), `snmp3` (USM `md5`/`sha`/`sha256`/`sha384`/`sha512`
    + `des`/`aes`, `report`).
  - **L7 Infra, Time, AAA & Telemetry (11)**: `dns`, `mdns`, `dhcp`, `ntp`, `ptp`, `radius`,
    `tacacs`, `syslog`, `netflow`, `ipfix`, `sflow`.
  - **L7 Web, Cloud, Security, VoIP & Access (16)**: `http`, `http2`, `grpc`, `websocket`,
    `tls`, `quic`, `ssh`, `telnet`, `tftp`, `ftp`, `whois`, `sip`, `rtp`, `rtsp`, `stun`, `ssdp`.
  - **L7 Mail, Identity, Storage, DB & Brokers (14)**: `smtp`, `imap`, `pop3`, `kerberos`,
    `ldap`, `smb`, `nfs`, `redis`, `memcached`, `mysql`, `postgres`, `mqtt`, `coap`, `amqp`.
  - **L7 Industrial OT / ICS & SCADA (6)**: `modbus`, `bacnet`, `dnp3`, `s7comm`, `ethernetip`,
    `opcua`.

## Prompt Injection Context & Formal Grammars

- [Full LLM Context](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/llms-full.txt): Self-contained `v3.2.1` prompt reference for all 81 protocols, examples, and EBNF.
- [ISO/IEC 14977 EBNF Grammar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/grammar.ebnf): Formal ISO/IEC 14977 `.frasm` `v3.2.1` grammar.
- [GGML BNF Grammar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/frameassembly.gbnf): `llama.cpp` and `XGrammar` constrained decoding grammar.
- [Lark CFG Grammar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/frameassembly.lark): Priority-disambiguated Earley/LALR grammar for Outlines, vLLM, and llguidance.

## Documentation & Use Cases

- [Repository README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/README.md): Overview, `cargo install frameassembly` quickstart, use cases, and CLI reference.
- [Official Documentation](https://frameassembly-lang.dev/docs): Getting started, Layer 2–7 protocol references, topologies & dual-stack, `.frasm` specification, and compiler internals.
- [Use Cases & Examples](https://frameassembly-lang.dev/use-cases): Ready-to-run `.frasm` recipes for SNMPv3 traps, firewall ACLs, VLAN/QinQ, SIEM/IDS, OT/SCADA, and topologies.

## Interactive Playground, VS Code & Rust Crate

- [Browser Playground](https://frameassembly-lang.dev/): Compile `.frasm` code to `.pcap`/`.pcapng` or reverse captures directly in the browser.
- [VS Code Extension](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=SteveWinschel.frameassembly-vscode): Syntax highlighting (`source.frameassembly`), live WASM diagnostics, and Quick Fixes.
- [Crates.io (`frameassembly`)](https://crates.io/crates/frameassembly): Official Rust CLI and library crate (`3.2.1`, MIT).
- [Docs.rs API Reference](https://docs.rs/frameassembly): Rust library documentation (`lexer`, `parser`, `backend`, `reverse`, `pcap`).
- [Crate Root (`src/lib.rs`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/src/lib.rs): Public Rust API and compiler pipeline entrypoints.
- [PCAP Decompiler (`src/reverse/mod.rs`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/src/reverse/mod.rs): 81-protocol PCAP/PCAPNG-to-`.frasm` decompiler.
